document.description: False retains canonical query/reference data without exposing a standalone document.

layout.description: Manifest only: the view every opening starts in. Readers may switch during the session.

heading.description: Manifest only: the document heading on Home. cover: the title box (and the cover sheet when pages lists it); compact: one line of organization, product, document type and title that opens the first front page.

pages.description: Manifest only: ordered generated front pages of the paged and PDF projections; each kind at most once.

title.description: Plain-text page heading; the cover uses the document title instead.

figures.description: Manifest only: numbering of captioned figure fences. Omitted keys use the defaults; the default none keeps existing documents unchanged.

numbering.description: document: 1, 2, ...; chapter: <top-level contents position>.<n>; none: no numbers.

label.description: Plain-text word before the number, in captions and unlabelled figure references.

labelPlural.description: Plain-text word before the numbers of adjacent unlabelled figure references merged into one.

attachments.removed: mark each file to embed with ![label](file) or ![[file]] and build with --embed-attachments; plain links only link.

print.description: Manifest only: paper and margin of the paged and PDF projections. Omitted keys use the defaults.

paper.description: A paper name from configuration's artifact.print.paperSizes, portrait.

margin.description: Margin on every side, in millimetres, for example 20mm; limits come from configuration.

cssSnippets.description: Manifest only: CSS snippet names, without .css, loaded in this order from the configured snippet folder (Obsidian's .obsidian/snippets by default).

query.description: Manifest: the global Filter's query profile, or one internal note link to a note declaring it (input-model).
